content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Article XII (p0128–p0129) is a one-way Licensee indemnity in the Licensor's favour, with no Licensor indemnity anywhere in the Agreement, and Article XIII (p0130) affirmatively disclaims all Licensor liability for third-party infringement claims — walk-away territory under INDEMN. I proposed a fallback-level cure: a new Article XII-A Licensor IP indemnity (with customary Licensee modification / combination / specification exclusions, procure-modify-replace and refund remedies, and a three-times-annual-fees super-cap), plus a surgical carve-out of that indemnity from the Article XIII infringement disclaimer and general cap so the new obligation is operative rather than nullified.
